description: TryLater, InternalError, MalformedRequest, SigRequired, Unauthorized all map to OcspStatusUnknown. TryLater is a transient failure, not an assertion about revocation state. Fix: return Err(Error::OcspMalformed) for non-Successful codes, or add OcspResponderError(OcspResponseStatus) to distinguish server failures from unknown-status.
